app_heading: Karta: Ibalazwe lefa lokuhlelwa kwezindawo eGauteng
meta_description: Ibonisa indlela ukuhlelwa kwezindawo ngesikhathi sobandlululo okusalokhu kubumba ngayo isikhathi sokuya emsebenzini nokufinyelela emsebenzini eGauteng.
map_aria_label: Ibalazwe lokufinyelela kwamalokishi aseNingizimu Afrika ezindaweni zomsebenzi
layer_failed_badge: Yehlulekile ukulayisha — vala uphinde uvule ukuze uzame futhi
layer_csv_export_error: Ayikwazanga ukulungisa ifayela le-CSV. Zama futhi.
error_boundary_generic_message: Kwenzeke iphutha elingalindelekile. Ukuvula kabusha ikhasi ngokuvamile kuyakulungisa.
layer_townships_description: Isikhathi sokushayela imoto esilinganiselwe kusukela endaweni ngayinye yelokishi eqashelwe kuya esikhungweni somsebenzi esiseduze esikhethiwe.
layer_nearest_transit_description: Ibanga eliqondile kusukela endaweni ngayinye yelokishi eqashelwe kuya emzileni osemthethweni wezokuthutha oseduze.
layer_group_access_to_opportunity_descri: Yingqimba eyodwa kuphela engasebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa.
layer_heritage_sites_description: Izindawo ezilinganiselwe zezindawo ezibhalwe ngokusemthethweni ezibalulekile emlandweni wokulwa nobandlululo nowentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika.
domain_gauteng_spatial_legacy_story_body: Umthetho wobandlululo wawulawula ukuthi abantu abaMnyama, amaKhaladi kanye namaNdiya bangahlala kuphi. Amalokishi abantu abaMnyama ahlukaniswa ngamabomu nezikhungo zomnotho, futhi lawo mabanga asabumba ukufinyelela emsebenzini nanamuhla. Leli balazwe likala lelo gebe ngesikhathi semoto esilinganiselwe nebanga eliya ezokuthutha.
domain_heritage_sites_story_body: Ubandlululo lwazama ukususa impilo yezepolitiki yabantu abaMnyama ebalazweni. Izindawo lapho abantu babehlangana khona, bekhulekela, beboshiwe, futhi bebulawelwa ukumelana nalo, zisekhona — le ngqimba ikhombisa lezo ezibhalwe ngokusemthethweni futhi ezivulelekile ukuvakashelwa namuhla.
webmcp_list_layers_description: Bala izendlalelo zaleli balazwe, ngayinye ne-id yayo, ilebula, nokuthi ibonakala yini njengamanje.
webmcp_toggle_layer_description: Bonisa noma fihla isendlalelo sebalazwe nge-id. Sebenzisa i-list-map-layers kuqala ukuze uthole ama-id asebenzayo.
webmcp_toggle_layer_unknown: Asikho isendlalelo esine-id ethi "{layerId}". Sebenzisa i-list-map-layers ukuze ubone ama-id asebenzayo.
webmcp_search_location_description: Sesha indawo ngegama bese uyisa ibalazwe kokuhambisana kangcono, isb. idolobha, isifunda noma isiteshi.
webmcp_set_theme_description: Shintsha itimu yemibala yohlelo. "system" ilandela okuncanyelwayo kwe-OS.
webmcp_read_story_description: Funda indaba engemuva yaleli balazwe echaza ukuthi likhona ngani, bese uvula iphaneli Yendaba.
